peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 6.5% above its local comparables; 79 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (7.4): 2.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 8 of 108 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2004.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kovan MRT about 100 m, Hougang MRT about 1,470 m; closer than 110 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest Xinghua Primary School about 810 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 190 m), more than 27 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre about 300 m; nearest park Surin Ave Neighbourhood Park about 450 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Kovan Hougang Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Serangoon North MRT about 1,290 m (LTA target 2030) and Defu MRT about 1,540 m (LTA target 2030), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 800 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 120 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 10 new sales and 711 resales (721 purchases); new sales were 1.4% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Hougang Central (government land sale site, awarded, about 830 homes), about 1,600 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 711 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 107 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 711 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 771 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.8%). Planning-area private resales −7.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
